test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) NJ-MP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5dfda3ccb4f4bbb7692566ab7e0b6a470db12d08faa9ad47e5619a5f48c31e35.png] 

Option 2) SO-RV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46217fe372801bc6ec276b249b4f86a49efa83e38e7465e1c87efb5caca47ade.png] 

Option 3) PL-OR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/122439fcaf7f3be48f3cdfe725011e0a2c53a8a69aa5a1973354968faf199b87.png] 

Option 4) LH-KN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c485cf5add1695911bff411d4fa9adc65eb9e4ccc3885c7372b23063c542a6b.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'SO-RV' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
